issue: DistantHorizonsStandalone #51 - Getting pretty severe TPS when installed on server

findings.summary: Severe TPS (ticks per second) lag on server when DistantHorizons is installed. The server tick event handler in ForgeServerProxy processes chunk load events and scheduled tasks with a 15ms deadline, but may exceed this budget.
findings.root_cause: ForgeServerProxy.serverTickEvent() processes chunk load events and runs scheduled tasks with aggressive time budget (15ms). The chunk generation in BatchGenerationEnvironment may also cause lag through world generation operations on the main thread.
evidence: ForgeServerProxy.java:136-142: Time budget check only happens after first task
BatchGenerationEnvironment.java:117-120: Comment mentions 'extreme server lag' with larger radius
ForgeServerProxy.java:121-130: Chunk load events iterated every tick - unbounded queue

primary.issue: 15ms time budget may be too aggressive; unbounded chunk load event queue
World generation on server thread may block tick

related.note: Core generation logic - may cause lag

gap_analysis.current_behavior: Server tick handler may exceed time budget, causing TPS drop. World generation runs on server thread.
gap_analysis.required_behavior: Server tick handler should be more conservative with time budget; generation should be off-thread
gap_analysis.invariant_violated: Server tick must complete within acceptable time (50ms for 20 TPS)

proposed_fix.approach: Reduce time budget for tick processing; add config for generation rate limiting; move generation off main thread
implementation_steps: 1. Reduce tick handler time budget from 15ms to 5ms
2. Add config option for world generation rate limit
3. Process chunk load events with limit per tick
4. Add profiling/timing logging for tick handler
proposed_fix.code_changes: Conservative time budgets; rate limiting; profiling

falsification_test.description: If TPS issues persist after time budget fix, root cause is in world generation off-thread handling
steps: 1. Profile with fix applied using /debug start/stop or spark
2. Check if lag is in tick handler or elsewhere
3. If generation is culprit, investigate InternalServerGenerator threading

confidence_reason: Clear performance bottleneck identified: aggressive time budget + unbounded queue. Comments in code acknowledge lag issues.
